I am an environmental scientist and spent four years at the **Beijing Climate Change Management Center**, a public body of the Beijing municipal government working on climate action. Since October 2025 I have been living in Stuttgart and am looking for a position in climate action, GHG accounting or sustainability.

## Focus areas

- **GHG inventories & climate strategies** — contributing to research projects for the City of Beijing
- **Low-carbon project management** — coordinating a pilot programme for innovative low-carbon technologies
- **International climate cooperation** — organising expert conferences, hosting international delegations, interpreting between experts and government representatives
- **Data & methods** — R, Python, GIS, LCA (openLCA)
